en: Local Boost Lab Privacy Policy — how we collect, use, and protect your personal data. Read about your rights under GDPR, CCPA, and CAN-SPAM.
Local Boost Lab Privacy Policy — how we collect, use, and protect your data.

Local Boost Lab ("LBL," "Local Boost Lab," "we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting the privacy and security of our clients' personal and business information. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, how we protect it, and your rights regarding your data. It applies to all LBL clients, website visitors, and anyone whose information we process in connection with providing our Google Business Profile management services.

LBL serves US-based businesses. If you are located in California, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) grants you additional rights described in Section 9. LBL does not intentionally collect data from EU residents; if you are an EU resident and use our services, please contact us before subscribing.

Publishing posts, reading and responding to reviews

We do not share your data with advertising networks, analytics platforms, data brokers, or any third party not listed above without your explicit consent.
We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data:
All OAuth tokens and sensitive credentials encrypted using AES-256-GCM
All data transmitted over TLS 1.2 or higher
Supabase hosted in US East region with row-level security enabled
All payment processing handled by Stripe, which is PCI DSS Level 1 certified. LBL never stores, transmits, or has access to raw card data.
In the event of a data breach affecting your personal information, we will notify you within 72 hours of discovery by email to your registered address.
LBL staff access to client data is restricted to those with a business need. All access is logged.
12 months after subscription cancellation, then deleted

You have the following rights regarding your personal data. To exercise any of these rights, email
with your request. We will respond within 30 days.

The Local Boost Lab website uses essential cookies only. These cookies are strictly necessary for the website's checkout and onboarding functionality to work. We do not use:

Essential cookies include session cookies that allow you to complete checkout and the onboarding form. These cookies expire at the end of your browser session or within 30 days, whichever comes first.
If you are a California resident, the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018 (CCPA) grants you specific rights regarding your personal information:

You have the right to request disclosure of the categories and specific pieces of personal information we have collected about you, the categories of sources, our business purpose for collecting it, and the categories of third parties with whom we share it.
You have the right to request deletion of personal information we have collected from you, subject to certain exceptions.
LBL does not sell personal information. This right is not applicable to our services.
We will not discriminate against you for exercising your CCPA rights.
To exercise your CCPA rights, please contact us at
. We will verify your identity before processing your request.

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes by email to your registered address at least 30 days before the changes take effect. Your continued use of our services after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

For non-material changes (such as clarifications or corrections), we may update the policy without prior notice. The "Effective Date" at the top of this page will always reflect the date of the most recent revision.

This section applies to businesses that use the Local Boost Lab WhatsApp AI Assistant and to the customers who message those businesses on WhatsApp. Where it differs from Sections 2 through 6, which describe our Google Business Profile service, this section governs the WhatsApp AI Assistant.

When we provide our WhatsApp assistant service, we process messages and contact information from the conversations that your customers send to your WhatsApp Business number. We do this only on your behalf and only to provide the service to you: to generate replies, answer common questions, schedule and confirm appointments, and send reminders. We use the WhatsApp Business Platform from Meta Platforms to deliver this service, and Meta processes information under its own terms. We do not sell this information, and we do not use one client's data to benefit another. Customers who message a business should contact that business directly about their information. We keep this information only as long as needed to provide the service and to meet legal and operational requirements. We follow the applicable Meta Platform Terms and WhatsApp Business policies.

The business that connects its WhatsApp Business number decides how its customer conversations are used. Local Boost Lab processes those conversations on the business's behalf, only to operate the assistant for that business. Conversations from one business are never used to serve another business, and we do not sell them.
The business's WhatsApp Business number and the access granted when the business connects it
Customer names and phone numbers as provided through WhatsApp
Message content exchanged between customers and the assistant or the business's team
Appointment details such as date, time and requested service
Business information used to answer questions, such as address, prices, hours and services
To answer customer questions on the business's behalf
To schedule and confirm appointments and send appointment reminders
To hand a conversation to the business's team when a person is needed
To let our team supervise the assistant's replies and keep quality high

Conversations are visible to the business that owns the WhatsApp number and to Local Boost Lab staff who supervise the assistant, under the access controls described in Section 5. Messages are delivered through the WhatsApp Business Platform operated by Meta Platforms, Inc., and reply text is generated by the AI providers listed in Section 4. These providers receive only what is needed to deliver and answer each message.

Conversation and appointment data is kept while the business's subscription is active and is deleted within 30 days after cancellation, unless the law requires us to keep it longer. A business can ask us to delete its conversation data at any time. A customer who wants their messages deleted can ask the business directly or email
, and we will handle the request together with that business.
